commonPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity mobile WeChat mini-program screen preview for a Chinese app named 毛毡生活手账. Output a single portrait image, approximately 390:844 aspect ratio, crisply readable typography. Entire screen visible, edge-to-edge app content, no physical phone frame, no OS status bar, no WeChat capsule, no external annotations, no watermark. Visual system: warm paper journal aesthetic, pale gray sage background #E8EDE7, mostly opaque cream paper #F7F2E9 with almost imperceptible grain, forest green #4D7D5B primary buttons with subtle darker bottom edge, charcoal text #302F2B, sage #8FAE92 secondary accents, minimal mustard yellow #C9A64B accents. Elegant Chinese Song serif headings, clean sans-serif body. Rounded paper panels, subtle cream borders and soft grounded shadows, restrained dashed dividers and occasional scalloped ticket paper edge. NOT frosted glass. Comfortable mobile whitespace and refined editorial hierarchy. The defining felt board is a FRONT VIEW HORIZONTAL rectangular physical display board, outer width:height 3:2, four fully visible continuous dark walnut brown rounded frame sides #493527, frame 8-12px at 350px displayed width, inset warm oatmeal beige #D9CBAF short fine felt surface, subtle inner recess and shadow. The board must never become a vertical card or unframed photo grid. On the felt are individual photorealistic cutout subjects with no rectangular photo backgrounds, narrow subtle warm-white contour edges and shallow contact shadows, like objects attached to a display board. Same board composition across pages: takeaway coffee upper left, croissant lower left, a small bouquet of cream/yellow flowers center right, book lower right; distinct natural scales with mild rotations and generous felt visible. These are real photo cutouts NOT pixel art, beads, cartoons or fuzzy felt toys. Board remains horizontal fully contained in portrait page with comfortable whitespace. All functional text Chinese, only exact short provided labels, no lorem ipsum, no ParkLog branding or park statistics. Display sample date 2026年10月13日, Tuesday when relevant.

pages.name: 首页
pages.prompt: Screen 首页「今天」. Top cream pill with tiny green leaf mark and 毛毡生活手账, below elegant large heading 把今天，轻轻收好 and small date 2026年10月13日 · 星期二. Dominant horizontal physical felt board showing all four specified objects. Under it small text 4 件记忆 and subtle 查看整板 link. Prominent full-width forest-green 继续布置 button. Lower cream ticket-edged journal section headed 最近记录 with 月历回顾 small calendar link aligned right, two smaller complete horizontal framed felt-board thumbnails labelled 10月12日 and 10月11日. Keep board the focal point. No controls on board, no check-in statistics.

pages.name: 毛毡板浏览
pages.prompt: Screen 毛毡板浏览. Cream light top nav with back chevron, centered 10月13日, right 编辑. Large elegant heading 今天的记忆, small 2026年10月13日 · 4 件记忆. Main center complete horizontal 3:2 physical walnut-framed oatmeal felt board with same four objects and composition. No selection rectangle or edit handles. Under board discreet caption 点开物件，重温这一刻. Generous breathing room, subtle pale green botanical strokes near outside margins only. Lower cream journal strip with small 这一日，已收藏 and forest-green 导出这一天 button. Screen should feel immersive and quiet, all four frame edges visible, not a grid.

pages.name: 毛毡板编辑
pages.prompt: Screen 毛毡板编辑. Top cream nav: back chevron, date 10月13日, small 已保存 status with green dot, right 完成. Heading 布置今天. Same full horizontal walnut-framed felt board with the four cutout objects. Coffee is selected: fine green rectangular selection outline around the coffee object, FOUR round cream/forest-green buttons anchored at four corners: top left counterclockwise arrow, top right clockwise arrow, bottom left minus, bottom right plus. Buttons readable and upright and not clipped by frame. Do not select board itself. Under board a modest cream detail strip with 咖啡的午后 and text 100% · 0° plus 查看 / 写下记忆 and low emphasis 删除记忆. Bottom cream paper toolbar with three equally spaced clear green line icons and text 拍照, 相册, 板面设置. No size/angle sliders. All controls physically tappable and not overlapping each other. Natural texture and consistent same board composition.

pages.name: 添加记忆
pages.prompt: Screen 添加记忆处理中, one selected coherent state. Retain same physical framed felt board and existing objects visibly in background, gently dimmed with no blur. Top nav back and 10月13日. Foreground opaque rounded cream paper modal centered in lower-middle area, clean heading 正在提取照片主体, smaller 上传完成，正在处理. Show two matching image previews horizontally: left 原图 showing a croissant on a breakfast table, right 主体预览 as a lightly outlined placeholder silhouette with subtle processing indicator rather than a finished successful result. Small green progress bar, sentence 完成后会直接放回当前毛毡板. Low-key 取消 button. Keep dark board frame partially visible around modal so context is obvious. No success toast, no 下一步 or 放到毛毡板 buttons, no stylization menu or crop editor.

pages.name: 记忆详情
pages.prompt: Screen 记忆详情. Top nav back, 这一刻, 编辑. A cream journal paper content panel on sage background. Large clear authentic lifestyle photo of a takeaway coffee beside a book on a warm cafe table, landscape image nicely inset. Below photo smaller cream paper section with elegant serif title 咖啡的午后. At right of title a small oatmeal felt swatch with the SAME takeaway coffee cutout used on board (thin contact shadow). Small green metadata pills 10月13日 and 日常. Body exactly: 午后的阳光刚刚好，\n留一点时间给自己。 Display as two natural short lines. Fine dashed divider then low-key 修改文字 and 替换照片 controls. Small muted red 删除记忆 near bottom; no confirmation dialog in this chosen state. Refined paper edge detail, dominant image and readable personal journal text, not park information.

pages.name: 月历回顾
pages.prompt: Screen 时光回顾. Top back chevron and elegant serif heading 时光回顾. Cream paper calendar panel with 2026年10月 centered and left/right month chevrons; right next month disabled, small 回到当月 control. Seven aligned Chinese weekday columns 一 二 三 四 五 六 日. ACCURATE October 2026 grid: first row blank blank blank 1 2 3 4; second row 5 6 7 8 9 10 11; third row 12 13 14 15 16 17 18; fourth row 19 20 21 22 23 24 25; fifth row 26 27 28 29 30 31 blank. Today is 13 with small mustard/green outline, dates 14-31 light muted future. Some past days 2,5,8,10,11,12 contain one or TWO small realistic transparent cutout life objects (coffee/croissant/flower/book) below date number, maximum two per day. No full framed board thumbnails inside cells. Keep dates and thumbnails readable, not overlapping. Soft very fine grid lines or whitespace division, pale paper grain, subtle scalloped paper lower edge. Below calendar short caption 每一天，都有值得收藏的小事. No timeline, no check-in streak, no bottom navigation added.

pages.name: 导出预览
pages.prompt: Screen 导出预览. Top back chevron, centered 收藏这一天. Subheading 把今天，留在相册里. A light cream paper backing surrounds a clean complete horizontal 3:2 artwork preview: same four objects on oatmeal felt WITH ALL FOUR dark walnut rounded frame edges visible. The exported artwork preview must have zero UI controls, zero selection outlines, no printed date inside board. Date outside preview 2026年10月13日 · 4 件记忆. Delicate dashed divider and tiny status green check 作品已生成. Large forest-green 保存到相册 button, lower subdued text 保存完整毛毡板与全部物件. Show preview-ready state only: don't falsely claim 已保存到相册. Refined warm journal feel, plenty of whitespace, subtle paper texture.

calendarRevision: Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Edit ONLY this calendar screen. Preserve the existing cream paper/sage background visual system, Chinese typography, top navigation, 2026年10月 title, weekday headings and accurate calendar dates. Two required corrections: (1) REMOVE the entire large walnut-framed felt board below the calendar. This screen is exclusively a month calendar and contains NO full felt board. Enlarge/vertically extend the main cream calendar panel slightly and use quiet sage whitespace below with only a small subtle leaf sprig, avoiding a second content panel. (2) Inside highlighted TODAY cell 13, add exactly TWO tiny real transparent cutout objects below the 13: the takeaway coffee cup and a croissant, matching the calendar's existing thumbnails. Keep mustard highlight, date number readable, miniature objects fully inside cell. Keep maximum TWO thumbnails per date. All dates unchanged: week 1 blank blank blank 1 2 3 4; week 2 5 6 7 8 9 10 11; week 3 12 13 14 15 16 17 18; week 4 19 20 21 22 23 24 25; week 5 26 27 28 29 30 31 blank. Date 13 green, dates14-31 muted. No new controls or stats. Maintain single edge-to-edge portrait mobile screen with no device border or watermark.
